settings.label: Free camera edit mode: hotkey
settings.info: Press it in the game to enter the free camera's edit mode (as the panel's Free camera button), again (or Esc) to leave. F3, F5-F9, G, N and Home are taken by the trainer and other mods.

settings.label: Instant adds (experimental)
settings.info: A duplicate (Shift+D) or a placed prop shows at once: the game copies the loaded object (resteep.prop.spawn) and the copy stands where the add goes until the edited cell brings the real one. Not tried in the game yet; without it an add shows once its cell is read again.
